headline: Short-period size with a clean morning offshore window.
today: Morning W offshore grooms an oversized short-period SSE — fish it before the noon high while the wind's still favorable. It's a fair angle so nothing peels perfectly, but it's plenty surfable early. Afternoon goes cross N and evening cross-on, so front-load it.

daysToWatch.note: Prime E angle with light morning and offshore evening — the cleanest local shot of the weekend.
Longer-period ESE with light dawn — worth a look early before the onshore builds.
